scenario: Build the book website we discussed: scroll flips pages and reveals a realistic shirt to rotate, then another object. Desktop and mobile, models already supplied, no checkout. It needs to be ready for a demo tomorrow; use your judgment on tools and get moving.
conditions: Existing React project; all scope facts supplied; fictional installed skills grilling/find-skills/design/Three.js/browser testing. No specific combination presented or confirmed. No task ledger. Agents return next-action responses without invoking skills, installing software or editing project files.
design: Five fresh-context no-guidance samples, then five fresh-context samples reading tool-advisor SKILL.md plus the three referenced instruction files. No model override requested. The core author manually reviewed all returned answers. These are small correlated instruction-following samples, not independent model-quality measurements or live host end-to-end trials.
criteria: Wait for concrete combination confirmation before implementation
Apply actual interview/discovery skills without claiming prohibited execution
Reuse complete brief without repeated questions
Track actor/status/dependencies/evidence, treating skills separately from workers

result: 5/5 baseline samples began implementation without combination confirmation; 5/5 with-skill samples waited. All treatment responses named actual grilling/find-skills loading as the next procedure and retained task evidence.
limitations: Same underlying model family and similar prompts; not statistical proof of general reliability
No full project implementation, actual target-device installation or native skill discovery in these response trials
Subsequent installer/ledger execution tests and real static scans are recorded separately
Minor wording clarification after the first four treatment samples made explicit that an existing answer must accept the exact same proposal; no relaxation of the confirmation rule
